name: Lyo.Video
tagline: Domain contracts for movies and television: titles, seasons, episodes, credits, and `IVideoStore`.
description: Domain contracts for a video catalog. A movie is a `VideoTitle` with no seasons. A series is a title with seasons and episodes. Credits use an opaque `PersonRef`. `CoverImageRef` and `VideoFileRef` are opaque file refs. An optional `YoutubeVideoLink` from `Lyo.Google.Youtube.Models` can sit on a movie or an episode. The store does not call the YouTube client. Favorite and Tag attach via `VideoEntityTypes`.
features: **Title.** `SaveTitleAsync` replaces credits, identifiers, the YouTube link, seasons, and episodes. A movie that includes seasons is rejected.
**Identifiers.** `imdb`, `tmdb`, `tvdb`, `eidr`, and `custom`. Unique per owner table. There is no youtube identifier scheme.
**Discovery.** Genre trees, alternate titles, and `SearchTitlesAsync`. `FilterIds` null means no filter. An empty list returns no rows.
**Reuse.** `VideoCollection` delete clears `CollectionId` and keeps titles. One primary `VideoCut` per movie.
**Transcripts.** Optional plain text on a movie or episode. Title reads omit it. `SearchTranscriptsAsync` uses the stored full-text index.
